chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
If a slain person is found and nothing is found except flesh without bone, then salat (prayer) is not performed over him; but if bone is found without flesh, salat (prayer) is performed over him.

key_terms.صُلِّيَ: salat (prayer) was performed over the deceased
key_terms.يُصَلَّ: to have salat (prayer) performed over the deceased

ai.seo_question: Is funeral salat (prayer) performed over partial human remains such as bones or flesh alone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding funeral salat (prayer) for partial remains of a slain person. It distinguishes between flesh without bone, over which salat is not performed, and bone without flesh, over which salat is performed.
